# I'm the Chef Too

> > Educational cooking and baking kits for kids that combine hands-on culinary activities with STEM learning through themed experiences.

I'm the Chef Too offers subscription boxes and themed cooking kits featuring licensed brands like Barbie, Transformers, and My Little Pony. The company transforms kitchens into learning labs where children develop cooking skills, scientific thinking, and creativity through food-based activities and educational content.

## Key Topics

- STEM learning through cooking
- Educational cooking kits
- Themed baking kits
- Subscription boxes for kids
- Hands-on science experiments
- Kid-friendly recipes
- Licensed brand partnerships (Barbie, Transformers, Hasbro)
- Dye-free baking products
- Early childhood education
- Family bonding activities
- Kitchen-based learning
- Age-appropriate cooking tasks
- Food science activities
- Creative cooking games

## Themed Cooking & Baking Kits

- [Dye Free Zebra Safari Bread](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/products/dye-free-zebra-safari-bread): Dye-free zebra-striped bread baking kit with African safari theme
- [Pharoah's Tomb Rice Krispie Treats (Without Food)](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/products/pharoahs-tomb-rice-krispie-treats-without-food): Egyptian-themed Rice Krispie treat kit teaching mummification (no food)

## STEM Learning & Experiments

- [Fun & Easy STEM Experiments for Kids at Home](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/stem-for-kids/fun-easy-stem-experiments-for-kids-at-home): 25+ easy STEM experiments using household items & food-based learning
- [Spark Curiosity: Fun STEM Ideas for Kids](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/stem-for-kids/spark-curiosity-fun-stem-ideas-for-kids): Hands-on STEM activities turning kitchens into learning labs
- [Sparking Brilliance: Stem Education in Early Childhood](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/stem-for-kids/sparking-brilliance-stem-education-in-early-childhood): Early childhood STEM education guide with cooking kit solutions
- [Engaging STEM Experiments to Do at Home](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/stem-for-kids/spark-curiosity-engaging-stem-experiments-to-do-at-home): Home STEM experiments with everyday items for critical thinking skills
- [Hands-On STEM Experiments for Kindergarten Fun](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/stem-for-kids/hands-on-stem-experiments-for-kindergarten-fun): Kindergarten-level STEM experiments with cooking activities
- [Fun & Easy Science Activities for Kids](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/stem-for-kids/sparking-curiosity-fun-easy-science-activities-for-kids): Kitchen-based science activities & STEM projects for kids

## Cooking Activities & Games for Kids

- [Cooking with Kids Blog Hub](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/cooking-with-kids): Main blog hub for kid-friendly recipes & kitchen activities
- [Fun Cooking Games for Kids: Beyond the Screen and Into the Kitchen](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/cooking-with-kids/fun-cooking-games-for-kids-beyond-the-screen-and-into-the-kitchen): Hands-on cooking games promoting STEM skills over screen time
- [Real Pizza Cooking Games for Kids: Beyond the Screen Fun](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/cooking-with-kids/real-pizza-cooking-games-for-kids-beyond-the-screen-fun): Pizza cooking games for kids with STEM learning & themed kits
- [Spark Joy: Fun Cooking Ideas for Kids & Family Bonding](https://www.imthecheftoo.com/blogs/cooking-with-kids/spark-joy-fun-cooking-ideas-for-kids-family-bonding): Age-appropriate cooking tasks for kids with STEM & family bonding focus
